title: Everyone Ends Up With a Sales Team. Even in the AI Era. The Team Just Scales Later Now.  See, E.g., Replit, Gamma, Lovable, Anthropic, etc.
content:
Amjad Masad, founder and CEO of Replit, posted the other day: “I thought I hated sales culture. By the end of this year, more than half my company will be salespeople.” He goes on: for most of the last decade he was a typical tech guy. Build a good product, put it on the internet,...
